news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Incredible Public Reception For The Paradise
news.summary: During a press meet in Hyderabad for The Paradise, lead actor Nani highlighted how the film's public reception transitioned from negative to positive across screenings. He praised the relentless dedication of the entire crew, technicians, and his co-stars in bringing the unique project together.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Character In The Paradise His Most Dangerous Role Yet
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu revealed at a media event that his role in Srikanth Odela's directorial venture is the deadliest character of his half-century cinematic career. He lauded the director's exceptional storytelling and praised producer Sudhakar for backing the ambitious venture without budget compromises.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Rare Audience Shift For The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani shared his astonishment at how public sentiment for his latest movie evolved positively with every successive screening. The Srikanth Odela directorial features a stellar cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar under SLV Cinemas.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters For Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Unveiled
news.summary: The makers of the mega-budget mythological drama Ramayana revealed striking new promotional posters featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra, the grand visual spectacle is scheduled to hit theaters globally during Diwali 2026.

news.title: Pen Studios Secures All-India Theatrical Rights for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love And War
news.summary: Following a massive deal for Shah Rukh Khan's King, Pen Studios has acquired the pan-India theatrical rights for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial project Love And War through a commission-based arrangement. Headlined by Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal alongside Supriya Pathak, the movie is scheduled to hit theaters during Republic Day week on January 21, 2027. Netflix has already secured the post-theatrical digital streaming rights for the venture.

news.title: MrBeast Makes Surprise Appearance at Ramayana Event and Chants Jai Shri Ram
news.summary: The makers of the Nitesh Tiwari directorial Ramayana hosted a high-profile gathering in Mumbai ahead of its Diwali 2026 release, drawing massive attention with the unexpected arrival of popular American YouTuber MrBeast. During the promotional event, MrBeast caught everyone's attention by repeating the chant Jai Shri Ram after a brief explanation from lead actor Ranbir Kapoor. Meanwhile, the absence of actor Yash, who portrays Ravana in the ambitious project, sparked various speculations among fans online.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address On-Set Clashes and Confirm Strong Bond Despite Mixed Reception
news.summary: Following the mixed audience and critical response to their latest release The Paradise, actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela opened up about their creative differences and arguments during production. Despite industry rumors of a fallout and Srikanth admitting that Nani occasionally shouted at him on set, both creatives clarified that their brotherhood remains unaffected. The actor-director duo emphasized that their deep personal bond and mutual respect go far beyond professional disagreements.

news.title: Veteran Filmmaker Mani Ratnam Extends Praise to Karthik Subbaraj's Progressive Drama Dorothy
news.summary: Acclaimed director Mani Ratnam has publicly appreciated filmmaker Karthik Subbaraj and his recent controversial project Dorothy, which stars Keerthy Suresh. The veteran director lauded the movie's narrative style, progressive execution, and bold handling of a sensitive LGBTQ-themed storyline. While the film continues to generate widespread debate and critical acclaim, its Telugu dubbed version has not yet been released.

news.title: The Paradise Team Celebrates Box Office Triumph
news.summary: The core team behind the movie The Paradise recently gathered for a grand success meet to celebrate the project's reception. Key figures from the film interacted with attendees and marked the milestone event.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Fans Seek Clarity Over 2027 Sankranthi Slate
news.summary: With the makers of Kaaka officially locking a January 13, 2027 release date, Chiranjeevi's followers have been left wondering about the status of Vishwambhara. Rumors of both projects targeting the same festive week have sparked confusion, prompting fans to request formal updates from the production team.

news.title: Mohan Babu Addresses Rumors Surrounding The Paradise
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu has subtly cleared the air regarding alleged friction and creative differences during the production of The Paradise. Speaking at a public event, he noted that clashing opinions happen on massive film sets but outsiders rarely understand the full picture.

news.title: Anirudh's Work in The Paradise Draws Mixed Reactions
news.summary: Despite his usually dependable track record, composer Anirudh's background score and music for Nani's The Paradise have faced criticism for feeling loud and dull. Observers noted that aside from the initial single releases and promotional concerts, the musical output turned out to be a rare disappointment.

news.title: Nani and Mohan Babu Celebrate the Massive Success of The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani recently shared his astonishment at the overwhelming response to his latest film, The Paradise, comparing its reception to a storm. Veteran actor Mohan Babu also voiced high praise for director Srikanth Odela and producer Sudhakar Cherukuri during a media interaction. Furthermore, Mohan Babu expressed enthusiasm for his intense character, Sikandar Malik, marking a memorable milestone in his extensive career.

news.title: First Look and Glimpse of Vikram Prabhu Starrer City of Gold Released
news.summary: The makers of City of Gold have officially unveiled the first look and teaser glimpse of the upcoming film starring Vikram Prabhu. Directed by debutant Siddharth, the project features Shivathmika Rajashekar as the female lead alongside a prominent supporting cast. Set against the secretive backdrop of the gold trade, the movie features music by Yuvan Shankar Raja and cinematography by Karthik Sharaj.

news.title: City of Gold Teaser Drops to Promising Response
news.summary: Vikram Prabhu's upcoming action drama City of Gold has generated considerable curiosity following the release of its first promotional material. The newly revealed visuals highlight an unfamiliar ecosystem hidden behind the glittering gold trade. Helmed by director Siddharth and produced by Romeo Pictures, the film showcases an intense lead performance and atmospheric visuals.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu Sticks to Its Sankranthi 2027 Release Date
news.summary: Producer Chaitanya Reddy has firmly clarified that Sai Dharam Tej's pan-India film Sambarala Yeti Gattu will proceed with its January 12, 2027 release. Despite overlapping with Megastar Chiranjeevi's Kaaka, the makers confirmed they are sticking to their original schedule since they announced it first. Directed by Rohith KP, the big-budget project has completed its principal photography while post-production and VFX work progress steadily.

news.title: Raghav Juyal Expresses Deep Admiration for Nani
news.summary: Actor Raghav Juyal shared an emotional note detailing his heartfelt appreciation for Nani during a challenging phase of his career. He credited the Telugu star for offering guidance and being a steady source of support while working on The Paradise.

news.title: Nagarjuna Secures Second Spot on India's Wealthiest Actors List
news.summary: The Hurun India Rich List 2026 placed Akkineni Nagarjuna as the second richest actor in the country with an estimated net worth of Rs 5,000 crore. This makes him the highest-ranking star from Tollywood, bolstered by family legacy assets, Annapurna Studios, and real estate investments.

news.title: Several Tollywood Actors Gear Up for Multiple Releases
news.summary: A number of prominent Telugu actors have lined up multiple cinematic projects heading into the coming months. Stars like Sharwanand, Vishwak Sen, Nithiin, and Dulquer Salmaan are preparing to test their box office fortunes with upcoming back-to-back releases.

news.title: Makers of Don't Trouble The Trouble Open Up About Production Hurdles
news.summary: Producers SS Karthikeya and Shobu Yarlagadda discussed the intricate challenges faced during the making of the Fahadh Faasil starrer Don't Trouble The Trouble. They highlighted the complexities of shooting across 79 distinct locations and emphasized the importance of rigorous pre-production planning.

news.title: Why Directors Struggle to Match Rajamouli's Meticulous Planning
news.summary: Producer Shobu Yarlagadda recently explained that SS Rajamouli's signature block-and-shoot method relies entirely on having a fully prepared script in advance. He noted that many modern filmmakers fail to adopt this rigorous style because they lack a finalized script before stepping onto the sets. Extensive pre-planning has been a hallmark of Rajamouli's major projects, including RRR and the upcoming Varanasi.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu Sticks to Its Scheduled Sankranthi Arrival
news.summary: Sai Dharam Tej's high-budget action drama Sambarala Yeti Gattu has completed its shooting and is firmly locking in its theatrical debut for January 12, 2027. Despite rumors of a potential shift due to competing holiday releases like Chiranjeevi's Kaaka and Vishwambara, producer Chaitanya Reddy confirmed that the film will not back out of the Sankranthi race. Post-production for the Rohit KP directorial is currently in its final stages.

news.title: Singer Chinmayi Sripada Encounters Online Flak Over Ramayana Track
news.summary: Playback singer Chinmayi Sripada has drawn sharp criticism on social media after announcing that she sang the Tamil version of a track for the upcoming two-part epic Ramayana. Netizens quickly dug up her historical remarks and criticisms regarding Lord Rama to question her involvement in the project. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the big-budget adaptation features Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi in lead roles.

news.title: Raghav Juyal Pens an Emotional Note for Nani Following The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Raghav Juyal shared a touching tribute to Nani, describing his co-star as a dependable mentor and safe haven during their time working together. He credited Nani with offering invaluable life and career guidance while helping him gain clarity on his artistic path. Both actors recently collaborated on Srikanth Odela's gritty action drama, The Paradise.
